summary: Propagate an uncaught synchronous throw from a normal function call to its caller with the original JS value.

target.notes: Reuse JsException wrapping; no Task/Promise conversion occurs.

semantics.boundary: ordinary function calls propagate throw completions synchronously
semantics.value: arbitrary thrown JS value is preserved
semantics.async_exclusion: async functions are handled by ASYNC rules

tests.name: side effect before throw retained
tests.input: let x=0; function f(){x=1;throw 2} try{f()}catch(e){} console.log(x)
